title: Hardrock 100 official homepage and At a Glance
claims: The homepage describes the run as a 100-mile run with 33,441 feet of climb, 33,441 feet of descent, 66,882 feet of total elevation change and an average elevation of 11,186 feet.
The homepage gives the low point as 7,680 feet at Ouray and the high point as 14,048 feet at Handies Peak.
The 2027 lottery is scheduled for Saturday 5 December 2026.
The 2027 Hardrock will be held 9-11 July 2027 in the counter-clockwise direction.
The 2027 run starts at 6:00a on 9 July 2027 in Silverton, Colorado.
